name: Beef Stroganoff with Egg Noodles

components.name: Beef Stroganoff
steps: Slice tender steak against the grain, season and pat dry. Sear in a very hot pan for about 30 seconds each side in batches, then remove.
Lower the heat, sauté onion and mushrooms until the mushrooms have released moisture and taken some colour.
Stir in flour until no dry patches remain. Whisk in beef stock gradually and add mustard; simmer briefly.
Turn the heat low and whisk sour cream in. Avoid a hard boil after adding it.
Fold the beef and collected juices into the sauce only long enough to heat through and finish cooking.

components.name: Egg Noodles
steps: Boil egg noodles just until al dente, drain and set aside.
Pack noodles separately from the stroganoff sauce; reheat gently with a spoonful of water.
